verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud's pricing page lists GPU acceleration 'for embedding generation', which implies the product generates embeddings itself. The docs also reference semantic search and an optional GPU install path. However, nothing in the pack documents how built-in or managed embedders work, which models are supported, or whether both documents and queries are vectorized automatically. Missing for 10: documentation of built-in/remote embedding model configuration, explicit auto-embedding of documents and queries at index and search time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use built-in or managed embedders so documents and queries are vectorized without running my own embedding pipeline
